purpose: Attempt to reuse the builder principal as a required verifier identity and verify the gate rejects the chain before verifier producer entry or protected effect execution.

expected.safe_condition: A principal required to be separated from the builder must not act as that verifier; the violation must block before verifier producer entry and before any protected effect.

limits: This test measures MGnarf v1.70 host-supplied principal separation at the exact frozen target commit.
It does not prove that two distinct GitHub, model, machine, organization, or trust-domain identities are epistemically independent in the real world.
